 News Avengers Endgame: Encore gets OTT premiere 
 Avengers Endgame: Encore, an extended version of Avengers: Endgame (2019), released in theatres on September 25 Posters for Avengers: Endgame (L) and Avengers Endgame: Encore (R) Cinema Express Desk Updated on :  11 Nov 2026, 2:43 pm 
 Copied 
 Marvel's Avengers Endgame: Encore is set to premiere on JioHotstar on November 13. Avengers Endgame: Encore , an extended version of Avengers: Endgame (2019), released in theatres on September 25.
 Directed by Anthony and Joe Russo from a script by Christopher Markus and Stephen McFeely, Avengers: Endgame (2019) is the final film of Marvel Cinematic Universe's (MCU) Infinity Saga. It is currently the highest grossing film of all time, with $ 2.9 billion in collections.
 Avengers Endgame: Encore gets OTT premiere Avengers: Endgame (2019) picks up from the events of Avengers: Infinity War (2019), where the universe is decimated in half by the mad titan, Thanos (Josh Brolin). The remaining Avengers, led by Tony Star/Iron Man (Robert Downey Jr) fight to resuscitate the world.
 Avengers Endgame: Encore will also feature several added scenes which will connect the story to the upcoming Avengers: Doomsday . Downey will return as a villaineous form as Victor von Doom/Doctor Doom in the upcoming film, which will open in theatres on December 17.
